• 2" PVC pipe (or 3" balsa wood)

4. Slide the PVC pipe between the two rubber bands; the rubber band acts as the seal.
5. Slip a heavy-duty wire or cable through the frame to the handle, and attach the rubber band to it.
6. Assemble the trigger mechanism using a microswitch or arduino-compatible microcontroller.
7. Test the electrical connection to the metal frame before finishing.

This setup is designed for a single-use version, so prioritize safety by treating all components as sharp and disposable.
